scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sea-trader/shared && concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w @sea-trader/server" "npm run dev -w @sea-trader/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sea-trader/shared && npm run build -w @sea-trader/server && npm run build -w @sea-trader/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sea-trader/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
